title: Publish: a signed Alpine repository
note: For postmarketOS phones: APKBUILD built for aarch64, signed, published.

title: Publish: a signed pacman repository
note: publish.yml: the Arch package built from the release's PKGBUILD, the repository signed, its page written, deployed only when every signature verifies, then installed from the README's snippet in a fresh container.

title: The declaration and its check
note: packaging/conveyor.toml, read by every job before anything runs; a missing field fails the plan.

title: The design, written
note: Its idea, decisions with what was rejected, and its path, from the delivery machinery of snapall and lab-agent.

title: Machines that actually receive updates
note: The lab machine updates lab-agent daily by a timer (grenudi/lab-machine). The phone, and other machines, still to do.

title: lab-agent on the conveyor
note: lab-agent v0.1.47 was the conveyor's first delivery (2026-11-11): every job green, the real install passed; 187 lines of copied workflow became a 20-line declaration.

title: snapall on the conveyor
note: Its published repositories identical before and after.

title: A passing mirror outage must not fail a release
note: lab-agent v0.1.51 (2026-11-11): both binary builds failed because the CI machines could not resolve Ubuntu's mirrors while installing musl-tools. Retry the install with backoff, or need no apt at all (a musl toolchain that comes with the Rust toolchain).

title: Release: binaries with signed provenance
note: binaries.yml: two architectures, deb and rpm, signed provenance, attached to the release; the PKGBUILD filled in.

title: The phone's shell shipped through it
note: Sxmo from its cutting, built as Alpine packages, installed on the phone, its health checks passing.

title: A typed reader for the declaration
note: A small Rust tool in this repository reads packaging/conveyor.toml into typed structures (unknown fields refused, required ones named) and gives each job what it needs; the workflows run it at their own version instead of inline Python.

title: Verify: installed on six systems
note: The six-system installation matrix (snapall's release-verify) is not extracted yet; publish.yml installs on Arch only.
